title: ISAIAH 44:3
BLESSING UPON OFFSPRING
end: The Family Altar — cover your home in prayer
stock_queries: warm lamp lit kitchen table with open bible
soft morning sunlight hitting olive branches
peaceful countryside home view at dawn
cozy living room with fireplace glow
macro shot of green leaves with dew

scenes.a: If you are weary of the spiritual dryness in your household right now, hear this.
For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and floods upon the dry ground: I will pour my spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:
Lord, we lift up every dry place within our family dynamic, trusting in your living water.
May your presence refresh the hearts of our children and sustain them through every season.
Let your spirit be the atmosphere of our home, guiding every decision and conversation today.
We rest in your faithfulness, believing that your blessing reaches deep into our family future.
